title: Concept: MD5 use via getMD5 (nim) — review required
description: In nim, getMD5 computes MD5, whose collisions are cheap to construct, so integrity or identity checks built on it can be defeated. The remedy is a modern digest (sha256) for security purposes.
applicability: nim codebases hashing with getMD5; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW severity.
